svg.text: MS05 376 cc · flange, pilot and shaft now separated in CAD · one driven end shown
EXPLODED REFERENCE — not a disassembly procedure
TEAL · Motor body, rear cover and front housing — profile segments illustrative.
DARK TEAL · Mounting flange: Ø300 bound; 8 holes on Ø265 pitch circle.
LIGHT TEAL · Pilot: Ø200, 23 mm projection; mounting face at Y1002.
SILVER · Output shaft: nominal Ø55 spline bound; teeth not modeled.
GOLD LINES · Coupling Ø160 ×140 and axlebox spaces — components not selected.
PURPLE LINES · Carrier space Ø350 / Ø201 ×20 — support structure not designed.
Nominal axial datums · mm · right-hand driven end
Axle end Y840 → motor shaft tip Y900 → mount face Y1002 → rear Y1208 → body plane Y1300
206 mount-to-rear; 308 maximum tip-to-rear; 92 static gap to body plane. Opposite motor is mirrored.
Missing: carrier-to-axlebox support, torque reaction path, rated coupling, fasteners, hydraulic fittings and hose sweep.
19 October 2026 · Catalog-reference geometry and reserved spaces; NOT OEM CAD or fabrication release.
